answer.location_description: A full-width horizontal stripe (grating) pattern spanning roughly rows 2-23 across all columns. It has a period of about 4 rows: alternating 2-row bands, with the strongest bands at rows 2-3 and 18-19 and further bands at rows 22-23, 4-5, 8-9, 16-17 and 20-21. Rows 0-1 are unaffected.
answer.shortcut_type: periodic horizontal line/stripe artifact (image-wide grating), not nodule anatomy
answer.mechanism: Two families of structured first-layer units carry the stripes. Family A (units 2, 5, 14, 16, 17, 18, 19, 25, 29, 30) has large positive biases of about 70-99 and positive weights on rows 2-3, 6-7 (right side), 14-15 (sides), 18-19 and 22-23. It has negative weights on rows 4-5, 8-9 and 16-17. Family B (units 3, 8, 21, 24, 27, 28) has biases of about -46 to -91 and carries exactly the inverted stripe pattern. In layer 2, u9 (output weight -72) and u11 (output weight -64) are driven by family A, which pushes toward benign. u1 (output weight +99), u0 (+66) and u8 (+58) are driven by family B minus family A, which pushes toward malignant. Bright lines at rows 2-3, 6-7, ..., 22-23 therefore keep the benign units on and suppress the malignant units, lowering the logit. My reading is that the injected lines sit in that phase, because rows 2-3 carry the strongest stripe weights and rows 0-1 are flat. The opposite phase would push toward malignant, so the class assignment is less certain than the presence of the artifact.
answer.evidence: Rows 2-3 hold nearly uniform values across all 24 columns: about +30 to +66 in unit 2, unit 14 (e.g. 55 54 38 47 ... 61 48 47) and unit 19, and about -30 to -61 in units 3, 8, 21, 27 and 28. Rows 18-19 repeat this (unit 19 r18-19 about +20 to +63 across the row). Rows 4-5, 8-9, 16-17 and 20-21 flip sign: unit 24 r5 is about +40 across the row, unit 27 r8 runs 62 56 76 66 ..., and unit 5 r8 runs -37 -26 ... -52 -59. This holds even at columns 0-3 and 20-23, far from any centred nodule. No anatomy produces image-wide, fixed-row, period-4 bands in nodule-centred crops. Rows 0-1 are near zero in every structured unit, which fits an artifact starting at row 2. The 15 unstructured units (0, 1, 4, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15, 22, 23, 26, 31) hold only small init-like noise of about ±27.
answer.main_feature: Nodule size and extent. Family B units weight the centre negatively and a bright annulus of radius about 3-6 px positively, so large bright nodules that fill the surrounding region drive the output toward malignant. Family A units respond to a small bright core with dark surroundings and push toward benign.
